$comment: Binaries and repositories that exist on one machine. NOTHING in this toolkit depends on any of them, which is why they are here and not in manifest/binaries.json: that file records what the toolkit needs, this one records what one person has. local/doctor.sh --profile checks these; a default run never mentions them.
movedFrom: manifest/binaries.json on 2026-09-20, keys machineLocal and relatedRepos

rtk.purpose: Token-reducing CLI proxy; invoked by a PreToolUse Bash hook on every command.
rtk.WARNING: Do NOT run 'cargo install rtk'. The crates.io crate named 'rtk' is a DIFFERENT project (reachingforthejack/rtk, 'Rust Type Kit'). Installing it replaces the working binary with one that has no 'rewrite' subcommand and silently disables the PreToolUse hook on every Bash call.

srt.purpose: Anthropic Sandbox Runtime. The OS-enforced boundary claude-safe runs Claude Code inside.
srt.reason: Cloud sessions use Anthropic's own per-session VM isolation. This is a separate, non-equivalent boundary and must not be assumed to carry over.

bwrap.purpose: bubblewrap; the kernel-namespace primitive srt builds on.

claude-safe.RISK: Has no git remote as of 2026-09-19. The hardened launcher, its threat model and its six test suites exist on exactly one disk.
